description: This file contains Sass mixins for styling button variants, including default, outline, and size options. It defines reusable styles for different button states like hover, focus, active, and disabled.

methods.name: button-variant
methods.description: Defines styling for button variants including hover, focus, active, and disabled states, with customizable background and border colors.

methods.name: button-outline-variant
methods.description: Defines outline style for buttons with hover, focus, active, and disabled states, using border and text colors.

methods.name: button-size
methods.description: Sets padding, font size, line height, and border radius for button sizing variations.
